sections.context: Serial CI rollout for all Warren-registered projects. Parent: ubuntu-6a44 at workspace root. Each child adds or verifies CI for one stack batch.
sections.approach: Audit github.com/ewardGPT/* repos for missing .github/workflows. Apply standard templates per stack. Commit, push branch, let Warren reap. Close child seed when CI file exists and is valid YAML.
